Class CraftTweakerMolecules

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.compat.crafttweaker.CraftTweakerMolecules
public final class CraftTweakerMolecules extends Object
CraftTweaker entry point: import mods.avogadro.Molecules;.

Definitions use the public Java builders and JSON schema. Nothing is installed until CraftTweakerMolecules.Definition.register() or registerJson(String, String) queues a CraftTweaker action. Scripts belong in scripts/*.zs; Minecraft 1.12 requires a restart after edits. One dedicated script owner keeps these definitions separate from Java and Groovy registrations. This class is discovered by CraftTweaker, never loaded from Avogadro's common entry point. Client tools live separately in CraftTweakerClient.
